message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I was scrambling to find our flashlights while the kids started a family group chat. Between the jokes about being in a real-life survival show and the debate over who would get to keep the last power bank, I couldn't help but laugh. We ended up sharing snack ideas to keep spirits high, and I made a mental note to add a few more lanterns for next time. It’s funny how a little darkness can turn into a bright moment of togetherness. Have you ever had a fun family chat during an outage?
